title: sync: reset `Barrier` state before waking the other tasks
body:
The leader path of `Barrier::wait` publishes the new generation through `state.waker.send(..)` before resetting `arrived` and incrementing the generation. The watch channel wakes the parked waiters synchronously inside `send`, so a waker that panics when woken (the trigger from #8560) unwinds out of `wait` with `arrived` still equal to `n` and a stale generation, and the lock is not poisoned. Since the generation value was already published, every later `wait` returns immediately as a non-leader: the barrier silently turns into a pass-through and never elects a leader again.

Reset the state before calling `send`, the same reordering #8560 applied to `mpsc::Permit::send`. The new test parks a waiter whose waker panics, trips the leader path, and checks that the next cohort still blocks and elects exactly one leader; it fails without the fix.
commits: sync: reset `Barrier` state before waking the other tasks
sync: drop redundant generation binding in Barrier leader path
